start: You're awake. Good. The system has noticed you too. Keep moving.
This is the Relay. I can't fight for you, but I can see what's coming.
Signal acquired. They'll come in waves. Don't stand still.
level: Every shard you take makes you stronger. Take all of it.
wave: Purge wave. They're closing a ring around you. Don't get boxed in.
Another ring is forming. Break through the thinnest side.
elite: Gold outline means it's carrying a Cache. Red outline means it's just tough. Pick your fights.

meet.patcher: Patcher. It has read your code and patched against your best line. Anything near it resists that effect. Your weapons still hurt it.
meet.scrubber: Scrubber. It eats code: pools, pull fields, shards. Kill it before it feeds.
meet.lancer: Lancer. It stops, aims, then charges in a straight line. When it freezes and the white line appears, step sideways.
meet.watcher: Watcher. It hangs back and fires down a red line. Break the line before it fires.
meet.ghost: Ghost process. You'll barely see it. Code Sight shows it plainly, but your weapons hit it either way.
meet.leaker: Leaker. It bleeds corrupted data. Don't stand in the red pools, and kill it away from where you need to be.

operator.ready: Operator line is open. Call me when you need something.
operator.supply: Supply drop on you. Patch up and grab the shards.
operator.rewrite: Rewriting the floor around you. Use the cover, it won't last.
operator.trace: Tracing the system. Everything worth taking is marked, and I'm pulling your shards in.
operator.strike: Override sent. I'm hitting the biggest ones for you.

exit.boss: An exit just opened. Step in and hold to jack out with what you've earned, or ignore it and keep going for more.
exit.root: It's done. The exit is open. Get to it and jack out.
exit.gone: The exit closed. You're still in. Keep going.

events.purge: The system left a gap open. Purge fast and I can pull a Cache through it.
events.beacon: I've dropped a beacon. Hold it so I can send you something. Stand in the gold ring.
events.storm: Data storm. Every shard is worth double for a while. Grab everything.

anomaly.stasis: The rules are breaking over there. Inside that zone everything moves slowly, you included.
anomaly.amplify: That zone amplifies code. Your hits land harder inside, but so do their legs.
anomaly.drift: Shards inside that zone float to its center, and each one is worth double.

world.convert: That one's listening. Keep it close and I can turn it to our side.
world.converted: It's ours now. It fights with you.
world.pod: There's a sleeper in a pod nearby. Reach it, wake it, and walk it to the exit. It will fight for you.
world.awake: It's awake. Get it to the exit and keep it alive.
world.saved: Out safe. It's staying with you.
world.trader: A rogue program wants to trade. Stand next to it if you're interested.

reflex: Reflex. Everything slows; you don't. Move.
overdrive: Overdrive. Keep moving and you'll keep it.
hidden: Something is buried in the code near you. Code Sight would show it. Or just walk over it.
threat: You're clearing them too fast. The system is sending sturdier code. Take a hit and it eases off.

warn.auditor: Something is auditing this sector. When the ground under you turns red, move.
warn.boss: The Enforcer is coming. It lunges. Watch for the white line.
warn.collector: The Collector feeds on loose data. Kill it before it eats your shards.
warn.mirror: The Mirror learns your weapons. The stronger you are, the harder it hits back.
warn.phantom: A Phantom. It walks through walls and through your fire. Hit it when it turns solid.
warn.root: The Root Process is coming for you itself. This is the end of the run. End it.

phase: It's adapting. Stay out of its line.
It's changing patterns. Watch first, then move.
Half its code is gone. It's getting desperate.
rootPhase2: The arena is collapsing. Stay inside the light.
rootPhase3: It's desperate. So are you. Finish it.
down: It's gone. Take what it dropped.
Deleted. The rain feels lighter already.
collectorDown: All that data it hoarded is yours now. Collect it.
evolve: That's not a weapon anymore. That's a signature.
Evolution complete. They won't recognise you.
low: Your signal is breaking up. Find integrity or get distance.
You're fading. Use a power, now.
win: Root deleted. For a moment, the rain is quiet. Then it starts again, and so do you.
lose: Signal lost. I'll keep listening for you.
You were close. The system remembers you now. So do I.
